origin:
Iron Lynx emerged from the passion project of two Italian motorsport enthusiasts, Sergio Pianezzola and Andrea Piccini, in the early 2010s. Pianezzola, a successful businessman with a lifelong love for racing, provided the initial funding, while Piccini, a seasoned GT racer, brought the crucial technical and driving expertise. Their aim was simple: to create a competitive amateur team that could punch above its weight in the Italian GT scene. The early days were a struggle, characterized by late nights in a cramped workshop, sourcing parts from wherever they could, and countless hours spent refining their aging Ferrari 458 Italia. A breakthrough came in 2015 when they secured a surprise podium finish at Monza, proving their potential and attracting some much-needed sponsorship.

Bolstered by their initial success, Iron Lynx gradually expanded its operations, acquiring newer machinery and attracting more talented drivers and engineers. They focused on endurance racing, recognizing it as a format where strategy and teamwork could compensate for a slightly smaller budget compared to the factory-backed teams. A key moment was their entry into the Michelin Le Mans Cup, providing a platform to showcase their capabilities on an international stage. Although victories proved elusive, their consistent performances and professionalism earned them respect within the paddock and laid the groundwork for future growth.
philosophy: Iron Lynx operates on a philosophy of continuous improvement and unwavering dedication. They prioritize driver development, providing young talents with opportunities to hone their skills in a supportive environment. Their approach to car development is meticulous, relying on data analysis and driver feedback to optimize performance. Team culture is built on a foundation of respect, collaboration, and a shared passion for motorsport.
achievements: Podium finish at Monza in the 2015 Italian GT Championship
Consistent top-ten finishes in the Michelin Le Mans Cup
Participation in the 24 Hours of Spa
Multiple class wins in Italian endurance races

teamPrincipal.name: Andrea Piccini
teamPrincipal.background: A former professional GT driver with extensive experience in various racing series, Piccini brings a wealth of technical knowledge and a driver-centric approach to team management. He is known for his calm demeanor and ability to motivate the team even under pressure.

keyFigures.name: Sergio Pianezzola
keyFigures.description: A successful entrepreneur and passionate motorsport enthusiast, Pianezzola provides the financial backing and strategic vision for Iron Lynx.

keyFigures.name: Marco Zanetti
keyFigures.description: Zanetti is responsible for overseeing the technical aspects of the team's racing program, bringing years of experience in vehicle dynamics and data analysis.

headquarters: Iron Lynx is based near Cesena, Italy, operating from a relatively small but well-equipped workshop. Their facilities include a basic garage, a data analysis room, and a small driver training area.
fanBase: Iron Lynx has cultivated a small but loyal following, primarily consisting of local motorsport enthusiasts and supporters of Italian racing. Their fans appreciate their underdog spirit and commitment to developing young talent.
